book.name: iLuku
book.title: Esɔ Osuse mi abɔ mgbi iLuku

content: Engyaa ama nwafɔ yi iYesu
Dafi egbe wa nyɛ gwee nɛ, iYesu le kyikyɛ nyɛ ifu igeli yi agwɔ idzidza-dzidza le gbɔ Esɔ Osuse mgbi esutɔ mgbi Imgbasho. Ama ogbikyon kyɛ yan,
bɛyi engyaa angbeka ngwu a ngyɛlu ma ootse onodzi ibwubwe bɛyi ootse ita idzidza-dzidza: li iMeri ngwu a li kwun di iMagidalin, ongwu a lɔ onodzi emɛsɛ tɔ mbon egyafa nani;
bɛyi iJoana, owa iKudza, nli ikye mgbi emi idɔ mi opiikwɔ mgbi iHerude; bɛyi iSudzana, bɛyi engyaa angbeka kwuba ama nli kye ungwɔ mgbi ama abuoma kye ya emi iYesu abɔ mani.
Utsa mgbi inggisɛ ofwe etɔ
Ngwi ibyi inggisɛ tole kwakye, angbeka dile ba mbi iYesu mi igeli idzidza-dzidza nɛ, iYesu nya ma odzɛ mi utsa gbɛɛ:
<<Inggisɛ ofwe etɔ tasɛ o ka fwe etɔ. Dafi o fwe nɛta, angbeka yangwuta mi ofɛ a kye afɔ dzin, ingwunɔ emi esho ba wa kyi salu gye.
Angbeka yangwuta mi akwutsɛ; dafi i lumbye nɛ, a ngwɔ dunto ikyekyɛ a tu eni ba.
Etɔ angbeka yangwuta mi ifaato, ato she bɛyi ama nu ma gbufyo.
Angbeka yangwuta mi ekyɛ osuse, a lumbye yɛ wa owawa akpe ngwuseda ngha ongwi a kye kya mani.>> IYesu si kwu ela gbɛɛ: <<Inggisɛ ndzɛ yi adɔ ofwoofwo yɔ, no fwo!>>
Itɔdzɛ mgbi utsa
Engwafɔ iYesu byun ita mi ungwɔ ngwi utsa nɛ tso mani.
Nɛ o gbɛɛ, <<Ema yɔ, a nu ema ye ungwɔ ama odaada ongwi esutɔ mgbi Imgbasho, kpaa angbeka yɔ, li mi utsa ta ngwi ani li gbɔdzɛ yi ama, ikyegbɛɛ:

content.text: ni a fwo kpaa ka gbosa loma ba.>

content: <<Li ngha ngwi utsa nɛ dzɛ aani: Etɔ, li elodzɛ Imgbasho.
Etɔ ama n yangwuta mi ofɛ na, i tso gbɛɛ dzɛ mi ikye ama nfwo kpaa iSatan ba wa kye gbɛlu elodzɛ na mi itukwu mgbi ama, ikyegbɛɛ nu ma dzɛ yi oyɛyɛ onuunu ni a dulu ma watɔ ba.
Etɔ ama n yangwuta mi akwutsɛ ma, a dzɛ mi ikye inggisɛ ama nfwo esɔ diyɛ kyi gbɛlu yi atsa, kpaa a yagba dzɛ yi akpa ba, a noyɛyɛ mi onɔ gwee ta, ngwi imbadi wa ba nɛ, a gbɛsɛ.
Etɔ ama n yangwuta mi ifaato ma, a dzɛ mi ikye inggisɛ ama nfwo, kpaa okakewo bɛyi aludu yi oshishe ofyunfya ongwi ɛsɛ nɛ loka wo ma nɛta, a yɛ wa owawa wuba.
Etɔ ama n yangwuta mi ekyɛ osuse ma, a dzɛ mi ikye inggisɛ ama nfwo elodzɛ mgbi Imgbasho, yilen sisɛ mi itukwu mgbi ama osuse yi osunu mani, a shitukwu nghataa yɛ wa owawa.
Utsa mgbi ipitila
<<Inggisɛ onyi dzɛma nka kye ipitila dɔ duuse yile mgboko tukwu ele ba, naadi yilen dzɛkɛ ifagwudo ba, kpaa o ka kye dɔkɛ mi ododa, ikyegbɛɛ inggisɛ ama nle kaka nu ma di osa!
Lubana alungwɔ ndzɛ mi odaada duu, a ka kye tɔ mi ododa, bɛyi ungwɔ ama ngwi a kye tukwu duu, a dika kye kwulu tɔ mi ododa.

Nghanɛ gbɛwɛbyi, mi ofwoofwo ngwi ema fwo nɛni, ikyekyɛ inggisɛ ndzɛ yi ungwɔ ma, a ka mbwon mbwoombwo, kpaa inggisɛ ndzɛ yi ungwɔ ba, ogyɛngyɛ ngwi o tsɛwɛ gbɛɛ ongwu dzɛyan ma kpaa, a ka kye gbɛlu mbon.>>
Onɔ iYesu bɛyi emi ongwunɔn
Onɔ iYesu bɛyi emi ongwunɔn ba mbon, kpaa a yagba to mbon gbɛ ba ikye ibyi inggisɛ.
Inggisɛ oka nyan gbɛɛ, <<Onabu bɛyi emi ongwunabu kwulɛsɛ to esɛ, a mina odi abu.>>
IYesu nya ma duu gbɛɛ, <<Ama nle fwo elodzɛ Imgbasho diyɛ kyɔ mi ele ma, li ama nli emi onani bɛyi emi ongwunani aali.>>
IYesu nu onikyɔ awo kwulu
Egbe oka nɛta, iYesu si kaka uwaa yi engwafɔɔn, o nya ma gbɛɛ, <<Eyi ka foyombo utɔ.>> A si kyato olu.
Ngwi a le lu nɛ, iYesu nauna. Nɛ onikyɔ awo ba wa fa mi utɔ, nghanɛ uwaa le mweeni, ta a dzɛ mi okakewo kpakpa.
Man a ba mbon wa kyilen, a nyan gbɛɛ, <<Ongyukwo, Ongyukwo! Eyi le dzili!>> IYesu kyato fa awo yi akpeni ela: onikyɔ awo kwulu, man imbe yɛɛ tsiin.
O nya engwafɔɔn gbɛɛ, <<Oyɛyɛ onuunu mgbi ema kɔ?>> Kpaa dafi i kwulu ma ewo imio diyɛ wo ma nɛ, a gbɔ yi ewoma gbɛɛ, <<Nɛnɛ li ali inggisɛ dɛn? O fa awo yi akpeni ela ta a fwon!>>
Inggisɛ iGeraseni ngwuesɛ dɔn ikye
Emi iYesu si fooye ka kaka ogalu iGeraseni, nli oyombo utɔ iGalalia nani.
Ngwi iYesu fa dɔkɛ esɛ nɛta, o tsa yi inggisɛ oka mi igeli nani, ngwu esɛ dɔn ikye. O nya yi angwuto owoowo onɔ kɛ, o di li la udɛ ba, li imbe endzi ta ngwi o li la.
Ngwi o di iYesu nɛ, o makwɔ mi ela okwukwo, o lankɛ iyayi, yɛ kwu ela mfyumfye gbɛɛ, <<Li ekyɛ wo abu yi ani, iYesu, Ongwɛ Imgbasho nngha mi esho? N le tɛkyɛ nu abu, ka nu ani adzɛ ba!>>
IYesu plɛ woola gbɛɛ, ni onodzi ibwubwe na tasɛ mbon. Lubana a li bwan mi onɔ ibyibyi, kye ashi won tan itse, ikye ole ngyon, kpaa o li gbɔdzɛ adi nani, onodzi ibwubwe li lɔn lu okwɛsɛ.
IYesu byun gbɛɛ, <<Iyi abu di emɛ?>> O nyan gbɛɛ: <<Ibyibyi>> bana onodzi ibwubwe kaka mbon kwuba.
Onodzi ibwubwe ntona tɛkyɛ nu iYesu gbɛɛ no ka lɔ ama onya ka yaokɛ ikplishɛ na ba.
Obyia ibyibyi kwuto le gye ungwɔ mi ewunggwɔ. Onodzi ibwubwe ntona si le tɛkyɛ yi iYesu gbɛɛ no nu ama ofɛ ni ama lu ka kaka obyia, man o si nu ma ofɛ.
Ta onodzi ibwubwe ntona tasɛ mbi inggisɛ na lu ka kaka mbi obyia ntonani. Obyi obyia ntona nyɛ yi onya kye ikye byi ufɛ lu ka yaokɛ utɔ si dzili mi eni.
Ama ntole ngyo obyia ntona di ungwɔ nkyɔ mani ta a si tsinya lu ka kye odzɛ nɛ gbɔfwɛ nya ma mi igeli bɛyi ama nto okwɔ mi agya na duu.
Nɛ inggisɛ tasɛ le ka di ungwɔ nkyɔ mani. A si ba mbi iYesu, wa tu inggisɛ ongwu onodzi ibwubwe tɔ mbon ma, sɔdzɛ iyayi mgbi iYesu, o wo angwuto ewo di dzɛ yi ozoyeye saan; ta i kwulu ma ewo.
Ama nteyi di ma nya angbeka dafi i kyɔ se inggisɛ ngwu onodzi ibwubwe kaka mbon na yɛɛ saan mani.
Ta inggisɛ ama nto ɛsɛ iGeraseni duu nya iYesu gbɛɛ no lu, ikyekyɛ imio wo ma. Man o si kaka uwaa lu.
Inggisɛ ongwu onodzi ibwubwe tɔ mbon na tɛkyɛ yi iYesu gbɛɛ ni ongwu lu yan. Kpaa iYesu nyan gbɛɛ,
<<Yɛ lu udɛ abu, ka gbɔ ungwɔ ngwi Imgbasho kyɔ yi abu nɛni.>> Inggisɛ na yɛ lu le kyikyɛ kɛ igeli-igeli, le gbɔ ungwɔ ngwi iYesu kyɔ yan mani.
Ongwɛ iJaru bɛyi ongyaa ndotse
Ngwi iYesu yɛ luba nɛ, ibyi inggisɛ gban yi atsa, ikyekyɛ a tole fan.
Nɛ inggisɛ oka ba, a li kwun di iJaru, o li ongyukwo mi ozu okwakye mgbi emi iJuda, o kwɛsɛ mi iyayi iYesu, si tɛkyɛ yan gbɛɛ no kɛ udɛ ongwu.
Ikyekyɛ ongwan ongwu ongyaa onyi kpokpo, ngwu mɛ onova iwyodefa, le fyikwu. Dafi iYesu le kɛ nɛ, ibyi inggisɛ tukwun kpakpa.
Mi idzidzɛ inggisɛ ntona, ongyaa oka dzɛ le yeeyi mɛ onova iwyodefa. O kye mbelu aludu mgban duu mbi ama obwotse, kpaa onyonyi yan abɔ ba.
O kaka ifu ibyi inggisɛ ntona wa kye abɔ gbo iYesu ondu angwuto mi iyikpa, labɔlabɔ mata eyi dzɛ lon.
IYesu gbɛɛ, <<Li emɛ kye abɔ gbo ani?>> Ama duu le tangwɛ, iPyita gbɛɛ, <<Ongyukwo, ibyi inggisɛ ama nkpakɛkɛ wo abu yɛ mba yi abu nɛ abu le byita gbɛɛ: <Li emɛ kye abɔ gbo ani ewoo?> >>
Nghaduu iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Inggisɛ kye ewo gbo ani, bana n kwu ambɛ dafi mfye tɔ mbi ani mani.>>

Ongyaa na di dafi ongwu dzɛ mi odaada wuba nɛ, o ba yi ewo otsaatsa wa kwɛsɛ mi iyayi mbi iYesu. O gbɔ mi inɛ mgbi inggisɛ tsatsa dafi i kyɔ se ongwu kye abɔ gbon ondu angwuto, ngwi ewo mgbi ongwu kpa di gbosa mina mani.
Nɛ iYesu nyan gbɛɛ, <<Ongwongyaa, oyɛyɛ mgbi abu onuunu dulu abu tɔ. Lu mi iyu.>>
Onɔ ngwi iYesu le gbɔdzɛ nɛ mata, inggisɛ oka mi udɛ iJaru, ongyukwo mi ozu okwakye mgbi emi iJuda na ba, o gbɛɛ, <<Ongwabu ongwu ongyaa na kwulu wa: Ka kaka Otsetse ewo wuba.>>
Ngwi iYesu fwo nghanɛ, o nya iJaru gbɛɛ, <<Ka teeyi ba, dzɛ yi oyɛyɛ onuunu, ta ootse mgban ka ngyɛ.>>
Dafi iYesu ka kaka udɛ iJaru nɛ, o gbela onu inggisɛ onyi kpaa kaka ozu yan ba, se li iPyita yi iJɔn bɛyi iJɛnsi yi otsɔ ongwongyaa na bɛyi onɔn ta.
Ali inggisɛ duu le tsukwu dile kyelela mi ikye ongwɛ nani. Nghaduu iYesu gbɛɛ, <<Ka tsukwu ba na, lubana ongwɛ nɛ kwulu ba, o nanuna ta.>>
Ama duu shan isha ikwangha, ikyekyɛ a ye gbɛɛ di o kwulu.
Kpaa ngwi iYesu byin abɔ nɛ, o gbɛɛ, <<Ongwani, kyato!>>
Ta oshishe mgban yɛ, man o kyato plɛ. IYesu si nya ma gbɛɛ, nu ma kye ungwogye non gye.
I kwulu ama o mban ma ewo, nghaduu iYesu wo ma ola gbɛɛ nu ma ka nya inggisɛ onyi ungwɔ nkyɔ nɛ ba.
